what: APi Group provides building safety and specialty services: installing and inspecting fire sprinkler and alarm systems, security systems, and elevator and escalator maintenance, mostly under recurring contracts required by law.
customers: Commercial and industrial building owners, data centres, healthcare facilities and institutional property managers.
money: fire protection and life safety inspection, service and installation
moat: Statutory inspections that building codes require every year, which creates recurring revenue and a service relationship that leads to repair and replacement work.
risks: It reported a net loss after acquisition and restructuring charges
opportunities: Analysts see about 30% upside from current levels
Inspection and service revenue recurs by law regardless of construction activity
watch: Safety Services organic growth and the inspection-driven share of revenue.
